desc:
SaaS product development with billing starts with the parts every software product needs before its first paying customer: accounts, plans and a dashboard. Ecom Swift LLC builds that foundation on a modern stack and deploys it to your own hosting and Stripe account.

## What is a SaaS product foundation?

A SaaS foundation is the set of features that sit under your actual idea. People must be able to sign up and sign in, choose a plan, pay, manage their subscription and see their own data. Your unique feature then sits on top. Building the foundation first means the product can charge money from the first day, and your time goes into what makes it different.

## Why billing and accounts deserve early attention

Billing is the part founders most often leave until last, and it is the part that touches everything. Plans decide which features a user sees. Usage limits decide what happens when a customer goes over. Failed card payments, upgrades, cancellations and receipts all need a defined behavior.

Retrofitting this later is slow, because every screen must be checked against the new rules. Accounts have the same issue. If user records, team members and permissions are designed correctly at the start, adding the product's real features is much simpler.

## How the foundation shapes revenue and retention

A clear pricing section and a smooth sign up path reduce the effort between interest and payment. A customer billing portal lets people update a card or change plans without emailing you, which keeps small problems from becoming cancellations. Welcome and receipt emails tell customers the purchase worked.

For you, a dashboard of usage and revenue shows how the product is actually used. An admin area lets you help a customer without touching the database. These tools support retention because they shorten the time between a customer problem and its fix.

## What a great SaaS foundation includes

- Sign up, sign in, email confirmation and password reset.
- Plans with clear limits, and trials where you want them.
- Stripe subscription billing, with webhooks that keep your records in line with payments.
- A customer billing portal for cards, invoices and plan changes.
- Team accounts with invitations and roles.
- A user dashboard that shows each person only their own data.
- A marketing page with a pricing section.
- Welcome and receipt emails.
- An admin area to view and manage customers.
- An audit log of key actions, plus automated tests on billing and access rules.

## What we do

We begin by agreeing your plans, your limits and the key screens. Then we build on a modern stack, connect Stripe in your own account and deploy to your hosting. The Basic package gives you accounts, one paid plan, a simple dashboard and a marketing page. Standard adds several plans with trials, team accounts, the billing portal, usage limits and emails. Premium adds the admin area, a usage and revenue dashboard, up to two core product screens, an audit log, tests and a code walkthrough.

We do not build your full product idea in this package. We build the base it grows from. The code and the payment account are yours, so the product is not tied to us.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write down your plans and what each one includes before building starts.
- Create your own Stripe account and hosting account.
- Decide what happens when a payment fails or a customer cancels.
- Test the whole sign up and payment path in test mode.
- Keep your terms and privacy pages ready before launch.

**Avoid:**
- Offering too many plans at the start.
- Letting any user see another customer's data.
- Storing card details yourself instead of using the payment provider.
- Hard coding plan limits in many places.
- Launching without a way to cancel or change plan.

## Who this is for

This service suits a founder with a validated idea who needs the shell of a product to start charging. It suits an agency that wants a reusable base for a client tool. It also suits an internal tool owner who wants to sell access to outside customers.

## What we need from you

Send a short description of your product, your planned plans and the main screens you imagine. Give us collaborator access to your repository and developer access to your hosting and Stripe account. We never need passwords. After you order, we send a checklist and keep you updated until the foundation is deployed.
